verdict.rationale: Medusa documents Order, Fulfillment (and related) commerce modules and maintains a full OpenAPI spec for Store/Admin REST APIs (medusa-gh-x1), and a working JS SDK was confirmed installable (medusa-probe-rt-2), giving an agent a technical path to read order status and manage fulfillment programmatically. However, 'Webhook Events' appears only as a thin pricing-page bullet with no doc content shown, there is no explicit returns-lifecycle API documentation in the pack, and no hands-on evidence of an agent completing a full post-purchase cycle (status→fulfillment→returns) without admin/human involvement. Missing for 10: dedicated returns/webhook API documentation excerpts, and independent/hands-on confirmation of an agent executing the full lifecycle end-to-end.
